Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP) Stipend Scholarship
ᐱ
ON THE PAGE
About this scholarship
NOTE due to a scheduled outage the deadline has been updated from 31 October to Monday 26 October 2026 - 11.59pm.
Please ensure you submit your application by the 26 October to be included in the Central HDR domestic scholarship round for commencement by the 30th March 2027.
Each year the Commonwealth Department of Education and Training provides funding to Universities to award scholarships to domestic and international students undertaking Higher Degree Research programs.
ANU currently conducts two annual central scholarship rounds which includes the RTP, the University Research Scholarship and a few other centrally managed scholarships.
Round 1 is split into two parts, one for international candidates and one for domestic candidates with separate deadlines (31 August for international candidates and 26 October for domestic candidates each year). Round 1 is for commencements from the following year (January through to the 30th of March), however current candidates who recently commenced (enrolled typically for less than a year full-time equivalent) can also be considered by completing the 'Request for a current ANU student to be considered for a HDR Scholarship form'.
Round 2 has a deadline of 15 April and is typically a smaller round with commencement or take up of the scholarship up to the end of August of the same year.
When you complete your admission application for a HDR program you can select which scholarship you are interested to be considered for including the RTP. There is no separate application form except for current candidates, through the above link.
Duration
Payments made for 3.5 years
Eligibility
Scholarship type
Academic
Student type
Domestic, International
Study level
Postgraduate research (HDR)
Selection bases
Academic merit
The Commonwealth Scholarship Guidelines (Research) 2017 set the basis for the conditions of award and outline the basic eligibility requirements for this scholarship.
Candidates are ranked and scholarships are awarded based on a competitive ranking process, to the top ranked candidates, subject to evidence they meet merit-based selection criteria, and subject to confirmation of a qualified supervisor, space and resources being available, in an area of research that is aligned with ANU research strategy.
Ongoing eligibility
Continuation based on academic performance
6 month extension available.
How to apply
No separate application is required for prospective candidates as all eligible will be considered based upon their application for admission. When you complete your admission application for a HDR program you can select to be considered for Australia: ANU - Other Scholarship to be considered for all eligible scholarships.
Current candidates (who have typically completed less than 1 year full-time equivalent) must submit the 'Request for a current ANU student to be considered for a HDR scholarship' form to be considered for this scholarship.
Key scholarship details
Application period
Open for applications
Application period is open all year round.
Value
$ 40,475 per annum (Full-time base RTP stipend rate 2027)
Number of scholarships awarded
Payments made fortnightly
Application requirement
No application is required for this scholarship as all eligible candidates will be considered.
Additional information
Selection process
Benefits
Reference documents
Further information
Candidates are ranked and scholarships are awarded based on a competitive ranking process, to the top ranked candidates, subject to evidence they meet merit-based selection criteria, and subject to confirmation of a qualified supervisor, space and resources being available, in an area of research that is aligned with ANU research strategy.
In addition to the fortnightly stipend, the scholarship also provides:
Travel and Removal allowances for students relocating to Canberra to commence their research program;
Thesis allowance;
Dependant child allowance (International students only);
Paid medical, maternity and parental leave
Higher Degree by Research (HDR) candidates who identify as Indigenous or First Nations People will be awarded the maximum Research Training Program (RTP) stipend rate as set by the Australian Government. International recipients will be eligible for OSHC reimbursement under their RTP Fee Offset benefit.
No separate application is required for prospective candidates as all eligible will be considered based upon their application for admission. When you complete your admission application for a HDR program you can select to be considered for Australia: ANU - Other Scholarship to be considered for all eligible scholarships.
Current candidates (who have typically completed less than 1 year full-time equivalent) must submit the 'Request for a current ANU student to be considered for a HDR scholarship' form to be considered for this scholarship.

In order to be considered for this scholarship in Round 1 (commencement of research program in following year), International students are required to apply for admission by 31 August. Domestic students are required to apply for admission by 31 October. Applications must be complete by the Scholarship deadline, including all supporting documentation and referee reports, in order to be considered in the scholarship ranking process.
Referee Reports & Submitting your application at least 2 weeks prior to the Scholarship Deadline
Request for referee reports are triggered and sent to your nominated referees at the time of submission of program application. Your referees must submit their reports prior to the scholarship deadline for your application to be considered complete. It is therefore strongly recommended that you submit your application in advance (2-3 weeks) prior to the deadlines to allow time for your referees to provide their report prior to the scholarship deadline.
Applicants are also strongly encouraged to make contact with the relevant HDR Convener or a prospective supervisor prior to lodging an application, to discuss the proposed research topic and related matters.
